implementation_summary: buildRoadmap groups ranked findings into one item per rule; each finding id is counted once and appears in exactly one item. Priority is the item's highest impact and effort its highest effort; pages are the union of its findings' pages. Items are ordered by impact, then lower effort, then first-finding rank. Phase follows priority (1/2/3), so phases never decrease. Ids are RM-n and the title comes from the highest-ranked finding. buildRoadmapDocument(view, lookup: LabelLookup, { showEffort }) builds the Improvement Roadmap AuditDoc from the edited view: phases in order, each item with priority, phase and effort, a findings table and the pages covered. showEffort:false leaves out all effort values, columns and wording. With no findings the document is a single nothing-to-order sentence that makes no claim about the site (ADR 0018). English and Tamil wording follows the structure.ts pattern.
